control_name: No circular ownership
design_note: an entity in its own ownership path would consolidate itself

control_name: Every consolidated entity has one valid ownership path
design_note: walked from the ownership register, so an entity the register omits fails here

control_name: Ownership effective dates do not overlap
design_note: an overlap makes the percentage for a month ambiguous

control_name: Ownership percentages are valid and complement the NCI share
The ownership register and the investment register agree
design_note: a subsidiary consolidated on a relationship nobody paid for, or an investment in something not consolidated

control_name: Second-tier holdings are resolved through their own parent
design_note: an entity held by an operating company rather than by Topco consolidates through its own parent; a flat register would consolidate it one tier too high and the group percentage would be its direct percentage

control_name: Every currency and period the entities require has both rates
iterates_from: the entity-period population that requires a rate; ref_cta_expectation
design_note: CTL-FX-01, iterated from the entity-period population that NEEDS a rate rather than from the rates that happen to exist

control_name: Every entity has a registered opening translation base
iterates_from: the entity-period population that requires a rate; ref_cta_expectation
design_note: FX-P16

control_name: Historical-rate equity is never translated at a closing rate
iterates_from: the entity-period population that requires a rate; ref_cta_expectation
design_note: FX-P03. Retranslating contributed capital would make CTA a plug rather than a residual, and the balance sheet would still balance

control_name: Derived CTA reproduces the independent expectation
iterates_from: the entity-period population that requires a rate; ref_cta_expectation
design_note: CTL-FX-04, CTL-FX-12. The oracle is read here and by nothing that computes CTA. Iterated from the expectation's population, so an entity-period the engine failed to produce fails the control rather than disappearing from it

control_name: The presentation currency generates no translation adjustment
iterates_from: the entity-period population that requires a rate; ref_cta_expectation
design_note: every translation rule must give the same answer at a rate of one; any difference is a defect in the rules themselves

control_name: The CTA roll-forward is continuous across periods
iterates_from: the entity-period population that requires a rate; ref_cta_expectation
design_note: CTL-FX-09. A discontinuity means a closed period was restated or the engine recomputed CTA from scratch instead of rolling it forward

control_name: The NCI share of the translation movement is allocated correctly
iterates_from: the entity-period population that requires a rate; ref_cta_expectation
design_note: CTL-CON-11. Allocating all of a partly owned subsidiary's translation to group equity overstates it and understates NCI by the same amount, and total equity is unchanged, so nothing else catches it

control_name: The FX effect on cash is not the translation adjustment
iterates_from: the entity-period population that requires a rate; ref_cta_expectation
design_note: CTL-FX-11. Routing the whole translation movement through the cash line makes the statement still tie while reporting an implausible FX effect on a mostly-USD cash balance: every balancing control passes and only this one objects

control_name: Every intercompany relationship nets by entity pair
iterates_from: ref_ic_side, the approved intercompany relationship population
design_note: CTL-IC-01, CTL-IC-02. Matched at the PAIR: a group total nets whenever everything happens to agree and says nothing when it does not, which is what fault F02 is

control_name: The intercompany population is not empty
iterates_from: ref_ic_side, the approved intercompany relationship population
design_note: a pair reconciliation over no pairs passes trivially, which is how a matching engine that stopped working would look

control_name: Consolidated intercompany balances are nil
iterates_from: ref_ic_side, the approved intercompany relationship population
design_note: CTL-IC-07, on the cumulative balance rather than the month's movement

control_name: Consolidated intercompany income and expense are nil
iterates_from: ref_ic_side, the approved intercompany relationship population
design_note: CTL-IC-02

control_name: Every intercompany difference carries a classification
iterates_from: ref_ic_side, the approved intercompany relationship population
design_note: matched, timing, FX, missing counterpart or amount mismatch. A difference nobody has classified is indistinguishable from one nobody has looked at

control_name: Every register relationship has an acquisition schedule
design_note: iterated from the investment register: a relationship with no schedule is invisible to a control that starts from the schedules

control_name: Every investment in a consolidated subsidiary eliminates in full
design_note: relationship by relationship, never at group total: a group-level elimination cannot express a second-tier holding at all

control_name: Every investment is eliminated in the month the register gives it
design_note: CTL-CON-02. Eliminating early removes equity that was still outside the group; eliminating late leaves an investment in a subsidiary the group already owns. Eliminating not at all leaves both, and every total stays plausible

control_name: Goodwill is the residual of the bridge and never a plug
design_note: consideration plus non-controlling interest, less the fair value of identifiable net assets, equals goodwill -- computed for every acquisition in the register

control_name: No acquisition produces negative goodwill
design_note: a bargain purchase is possible but would be a disclosure, not a silent balance

control_name: Deferred tax on the fair value uplift follows the schedule's rate
Every goodwill posting names the acquisition it arose on
design_note: goodwill that cannot be traced to an acquisition is a balance nobody can explain and nobody can impair

control_name: Every intangible tranche has an amortisation schedule
design_note: iterated from the PPA register

control_name: Amortisation begins in the month the acquisition completes
design_note: starting at the beginning of the acquisition year overstates the charge by the months before it: small, plausible and entirely wrong

control_name: No intangible amortises past its cost
Gross less accumulated amortisation equals net book value
design_note: the roll-forward closes every period

control_name: Every entity with a non-controlling interest is allocated one
design_note: iterated from the ownership register's non-controlling percentages, so an entity the engine failed to allocate fails here rather than being absent

control_name: The NCI share uses the entity's own effective percentage
design_note: computed on NIG-510's result at its own 20%, never on a group total and never by applying a percentage twice down the ownership chain

control_name: The NCI result is attributed once per entity and period
design_note: a second allocation would double the minority's share

control_name: The NCI roll-forward closes every year
design_note: opening plus the share of result, less distributions, plus the share of translation, plus ownership movements, equals closing

control_name: The NCI charge sits below tax and never inside EBITDA
design_note: the credit agreement defines Consolidated EBITDA on the group, not on the group's economic share, so covenant leverage is calculated on the 100% basis

control_name: Unrealised profit reproduces the independent expectation
design_note: computed from the surviving FIFO layers at each layer's own margin. The holdings file's own unrealised-profit column is read here and by nothing that computes it

control_name: Every intercompany sale reaches the calculation at its own value
threshold: all of them, at the transacted value

control_name: Prior-period unrealised profit reverses as the stock is sold on
design_note: posted as the movement in the provision, so the release happens by construction. A provision that only ever grows is one that is never released

control_name: Each surviving layer carries its own margin
design_note: a buyer holding two months of purchases at 12% and 9% does not hold them at 10.5%

control_name: Every consolidation entry in layers 2 to 4 balances
design_note: layer 5 is excluded by design: it IS the entry that makes the translated trial balance sum to zero, so it does not balance alone

control_name: Only the declared consolidation layers are posted
design_note: CTL-CON-09. Layer 1 originates outside this phase and is never written here

control_name: Layers 1 and 5 together sum to zero in every period
design_note: CTL-TB-03. This is what CTA IS, so it is the only form in which layer 5 can be tested for balance

control_name: No management adjustment reaches the statutory basis
design_note: the statutory basis is layers 1, 2, 3, 5, selected at the architecture level rather than filtered at report time

control_name: The management basis contains every layer it should
design_note: layers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

control_name: No source ledger carries a translation adjustment or reserve
design_note: a source-layer CTA would be a plug, and the balance sheet would balance around it

control_name: The journal fact and the financial fact reconcile exactly
iterates_from: fact_consol_journal and fact_financials, compared row for row
design_note: ADR-0024. Two facts are held so that a total can be queried and an entry can be read; they are only safe to hold while they agree

control_name: The entity ledgers are never copied into the journal fact
iterates_from: fact_consol_journal and fact_financials, compared row for row
design_note: layer 1 originates in the frozen Phase 3 conformed layer. A consolidation entry carrying it would make the reported figures depend on this phase

control_name: Assets equal liabilities plus equity in every period
design_note: no balancing account, no residual reserve and no forced caption

control_name: Every balance sheet account maps to exactly one caption
design_note: an account in two captions is counted twice and the statement still balances

control_name: No balance sheet account is left without a caption
design_note: an account with no caption disappears from the statement while staying in the fact

control_name: No income statement caption appears in the balance sheet
design_note: the result appears once, as its own equity line, and never as a P&L caption

control_name: The period result appears exactly once in equity
design_note: it is the cumulative income statement balance INCLUDING the close. Excluding the close counts every closed year twice, once here and once in retained earnings

control_name: The income statement is internally consistent
design_note: gross profit and EBIT follow from their components

control_name: The cash flow ties in every period
iterates_from: dim_account cash flow categories; rpt_balance_sheet cash
design_note: opening plus operating, investing, financing and the effect of exchange rates equals closing, at the cent, in all 48 periods. Cash is never the residual, and the translation carried by the year-end close is presented as its own line rather than left to be absorbed by whichever bucket is nearest

control_name: Closing cash ties to the consolidated balance sheet
iterates_from: dim_account cash flow categories; rpt_balance_sheet cash

control_name: Every balance sheet account has exactly one cash flow category
iterates_from: dim_account cash flow categories; rpt_balance_sheet cash
design_note: CTL-FS-04. The statement ties by construction only if the categories partition the balance sheet; a mis-categorised account still ties while reporting the wrong line

control_name: Management less statutory equals layer 4, for every headline measure
design_note: revenue, gross profit, EBITDA, EBIT, net income, total assets and total equity, each of four years. Any other difference would mean the two bases diverge somewhere the layer architecture does not describe

control_name: Layer 4 is empty under the approved adjustment register
design_note: Both approved adjustments (MA-001, MA-002) are presentation reclassifications carrying a nil amount, so no layer-4 entry is posted and the management basis is numerically identical to the statutory basis for FY2023-FY2026. P4-BAS-01 and P4-LAY-03 therefore prove the architecture separates the bases but cannot prove it from production data. Fault fixture F4-MGT-LEAK supplies that proof by injecting a layer-4 adjustment and showing the statutory basis unmoved. An amount is NOT invented here to make the comparison look richer.

control_name: Only approved management adjustments are posted
design_note: iterated from the adjustment register. An adjustment nobody has approved is a proposal, and a management view built on proposals is not a management view

control_name: No management adjustment is anonymous
design_note: CTL-CON-07

control_name: Adjusted and covenant EBITDA are computed separately
design_note: the credit agreement caps the sponsor fee (CA-027) and permits unrealised foreign exchange (CA-030) where the management policy does neither, so the two measures are not assumed to be the same number

control_name: The income statement reconciles to the consolidated fact
iterates_from: the consolidated fact, recomputed -- never the artefact being tested
design_note: revenue, gross profit, EBITDA, EBIT, net income and net income attributable to the parent, each recomputed from the fact rather than read back from the artefact being tested. Business consequence: the primary statement the board reads does not agree with the ledger it is drawn from

control_name: The EBITDA bridge's statutory EBITDA equals the fact's
iterates_from: the consolidated fact, recomputed -- never the artefact being tested
design_note: P4-D-02. Summing a fiscal year without excluding the year-end close nets it to approximately nil, and three of four years were wrong by the whole year's EBITDA while the income statement was right. Business consequence: two artefacts state different EBITDA and nothing says which is the group's

control_name: Adjusted EBITDA is the fact plus the approved add-backs plus layer 4
iterates_from: the consolidated fact, recomputed -- never the artefact being tested
design_note: the layer-4 effect is added rather than assumed nil, so the control still holds when a management adjustment is approved. Business consequence: the headline management measure diverges from the statutory base it is built on

control_name: Covenant EBITDA is complete, non-null and reconciles to the fact
iterates_from: the consolidated fact, recomputed -- never the artefact being tested
design_note: P4-D-02. An add-back category with no population contributes ZERO, never NULL: a nil FILTER voided the whole expression and every year came back NULL. Business consequence: this is the measure the credit agreement tests leverage on, and a null or wrong Covenant EBITDA misstates headroom to a lender

control_name: Total assets, liabilities and equity reconcile to the fact
iterates_from: the consolidated fact, recomputed -- never the artefact being tested
design_note: equity on the fact side includes the unclosed income statement balance, because that is what the balance sheet presents inside equity. Business consequence: the primary statement does not agree with the ledger

control_name: The period result in equity is the fiscal year to date from the fact
iterates_from: the consolidated fact, recomputed -- never the artefact being tested
design_note: P4-D-01. The caption presented the cumulative income statement including the close, which is only complete for layer 1: no entity ledger closes a consolidation adjustment, so three years of them accumulated in a caption called the period's result. Business consequence: a reader cannot reconcile the balance sheet to the income statement, and total equity is right the whole time

control_name: Retained earnings plus the period result equal the fact's earnings
iterates_from: the consolidated fact, recomputed -- never the artefact being tested
design_note: the split between the two captions is a presentation decision and the total is not. P4-XAR-06 tests the split; this tests that moving it never changes the total. Business consequence: earnings created or destroyed by presentation

control_name: The CTA caption reconciles to the fact's translation accounts
iterates_from: the consolidated fact, recomputed -- never the artefact being tested
design_note: business consequence: the equity reserve that explains every rate movement does not agree with the entries that produced it

control_name: The NCI caption agrees with the NCI roll-forward at each year end
iterates_from: the consolidated fact, recomputed -- never the artefact being tested
design_note: two artefacts, one measure: the balance sheet's equity component and the roll-forward that explains it. Business consequence: the minority's stake is reported at one figure and explained by another

control_name: Closing cash agrees across the cash flow, the balance sheet and the fact
iterates_from: the consolidated fact, recomputed -- never the artefact being tested
design_note: a three-way tie with the fact as the authority, so an artefact that agrees with the other artefact but not with the ledger still fails. Business consequence: the single number every reader checks first

control_name: The layer bridge sums to the fact's net income
iterates_from: the consolidated fact, recomputed -- never the artefact being tested
design_note: the artefact that answers 'where did this number come from' has to arrive at the number. Business consequence: a bridge that does not bridge
